extracted.name: Manhattan Cocktail
extracted.description: Learn how to make a Manhattan cocktail with this classic recipe! One of Jack's favorite drinks, it's aromatic, warming, and easy to make with 3 ingredients.
ingredient_lines: Brandied cherry or lemon twist (for garnish, optional)
instruction_lines: Add the rye, vermouth, bitters, and a few ice cubes to a mixing glass. Stir until chilled.
Strain into a coupe glass. Garnish with a brandied cherry or lemon twist and serve.
